page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Running head centred at the top. Printed page number at the top right. Below the last text line, catchword at the right and gathering signature at the left-centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: causa cur tali chartæ nihil inscribatur, resp.
est à penna non-denigrante : abfentia deni-
grationis, & abfentia non-denigrationis ar-
tificiosæ est à scribente artem suam negante.
Ideoque ex hac Dei causatione sequitur nuda
non conversio physica & negativa, non pro-
prie conversio privativa & culpabilis. Nam
ex causa præcise physica non sequitur ullo
modo culpa. Culpa enim est defectus mo-
ralis, ideoque ortum habere non potest, nisi
ex causa morali & deficiente: ideoque ex non
appositione fulcri physice sequitur ruina ædium
physica ut habet similitudo Arm.Si dominus te-
neatur ædes servo suo suppositis fulcris susten-
tare, casus ædium moraliter imputatur domino
non apponenti fulcra, quæ ex pacto aut data fi-
de apponere debuit, & hoc posteriore sensu si-
mile Arminianū urget, & tamen nihil concludit.
Deus enim ex debito neminem convertit,
sed ex beneplacito suo.' Secundo modo, si
consideretur Deus, ut agens ex beneplacito
suo, cujusmodi agens tantum hic est Deus,
nullo modo imputatur moraliter non-con-
versio Deo. Non enim pacto, statuto aut
ullo officio Deus se astrinxit ad homines con-
vertendos. Nam non extat statutum aut
pactum illud Dei ex promissione ulla [hoc
fac, & ego te efficaciter vocabo:] [qui hoc
fecerit, conversionis mercedem facti in la-
boris compensationem repertabit.] Iam quo-
niam hoc in tota scriptura, aut ex ullo Dei
attributo Arminiani, & Iesuitæ ad hunc usque

page.notes: Printed "Hh 5" at the foot read as a signature; the 5 is slightly unclear. Printed "fuo.'" in the second paragraph carries a closing quote mark as printed. Line-end hyphens are kept: deni-, ar-, pro-, te-, non-con-, con-, la-, quo-, and the hyphen in "sus-ten-" is joined as "sustentare" across the line break, with the printed hyphen kept at the line end. Long s and s are rendered as plain s throughout. Bracketed text "[hoc fac ... repertabit.]" is printed in square brackets in the original.
